prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium Japanese yarn shop autumn/winter mobile hero photograph, portrait 2:3, highest native resolution. Rebuild the supplied previous basket image with much stronger authentic lived-in room depth and faithful product textures. No text or graphics.

REFERENCE ROLES: r1/m3.png is the prior composition to improve, not a quality target. site_wide.png and room_mobile.png define the warm real craft room, subtle cream plaster, aged honey oak and jute. logo.png is terracotta color reference only, never render logo. Five s3 product photographs are authoritative for product colors, fibers and winding, NOT their labels, backgrounds or props.

HARD SAFE AREAS: top 14% calm cream plaster. Rectangle x=8–85%, y=18–49% must be uninterrupted softly lit cream plaster, no furniture, curtain, strong window shadows or objects. All recognizable objects and subjects start below y=58%. Keep room storytelling in LOWER 42%, not across copy area. No tall chair back invading wall. Gentle natural wall illumination may vary broadly without sharp shadow in copy area. Do not interpret this as a studio seamless background.

COMPOSITION AND ROOM DEPTH: low oval woven basket is the sole hero, at x=8–89%, y=66–95%, yarn tops no higher than y=61%. Full basket fits with margins, resting on worn natural jute rug. View slightly down at oblique angles, not a symmetric line-up. Behind basket leave a visible strip of oak floor receding toward the back wall, wall/floor junction near y=60%. At rear right, a small LOW honey oak cubby shelf starts below y=59%, several feet behind basket, holds a few loosely wound unlabelled muted yarn balls; partially cropped by right frame and partly hidden by basket. Shelf perspective, diminishing scale, darker recesses and floor planes give genuine depth. At extreme lower left, a sliver of flax linen curtain appears only below y=58%, illuminated by an off-camera window. A small terracotta ceramic cup sits on the rear low shelf on a casually creased tiny butter-yellow linen cloth. One small muted terracotta linen fold beside basket at lower right, never covering products. No plants or vases, no big blankets, no finished knitwear. Restrained props, not a decor catalogue. Slight floor scuffs, tiny oak dents, uneven rug edge, believable joinery and subtle wear.

FIVE HERO PRODUCTS, each physically supported and distinct:
Front left: oil-painting boucle yarn, short cylindrical cake, reference foreground colorway, fine SMALL irregular boucle loops and fuzz, forest-green lower sides with cobalt, slate blue, mustard and coral/salmon irregular bands and coral center. Not crocheted fabric, not thick popcorn stitches or regular beads. Top oblique, not perfectly facing viewer.
Rear left: Magic Ball feathered long-pile gradient cake, peach pink core through ivory to pale icy aqua outside, broad gradual transition, fine long soft fibers with coherent wound strands beneath. Tilt back and sideways, naturally overlap lower portion.
Rear middle: Impression Sunrise green cake, emerald/leaf green, mint and pale celadon creamy undulating concentric winding, delicate fuzzy strands; match large foreground green cake in source, subtle irregular center not an artificial five-point star. Oblique face, not frontal.
Right: Xuebao pale silver/light lilac-gray soft oblong center-pull ball, wispy fine fuzzy fibers with diagonal underlying winding and slight center indentation. Do not turn into a perfect sphere or pompom.
Front middle: Hand-knitting No.2 section dyed yarn, a distinctly HORIZONTAL OBLONG center-pull skein, smooth visibly plied strands with repeated pastel yellow, peach/coral, light lilac, mint and pale sky blue sections. Crisscross winding as source, NOT a spherical ball and NOT concentric gradient cake. Partly nestled into basket.
Keep original product colors, no brand-color recoloring. No wrappers, tags or lettering. A single natural yarn tail attached visibly to the boucle cake can drape inside basket and over its lower rim, resting on rug with gravity.

PHOTOGRAPHY: real 50mm full-frame editorial lifestyle photograph, f/4-like moderate natural depth of field; crisp tactile foreground yarn with authentic fine filament detail, softly receding but legible background furniture. Late afternoon directional window light from left: broad soft light on yarn, gentle cool-neutral shaded right sides, reflected warm oak bounce, distinct but soft contact shadows between objects. A restrained window-light patch crosses floor below y=59% and fades behind basket; no strong pattern in copy area. Cream remains neutral, no orange filter. Rich nuanced shadows, no flat washout. Natural irregular wicker construction and strand continuity, honest material texture, no excessive halos, no glowing fuzz, no cloning, no impossible woven loops, no fake blur, no CGI or illustration. No people, animals, text, numbers, labels, logos or UI.

Generation input images: five product references only (tool accepts at most five images).

FINAL REFRAMING PASS (input: first generated photograph):
CRITICAL GEOMETRY EDIT. Preserve this photograph's five yarn identities, natural room materials, directional window lighting and terracotta/butter accents, but radically reframe by pulling camera far back and aiming higher. Portrait 2:3. The TOP 58 PERCENT must be NOTHING BUT continuous quiet cream plaster, edge to edge. First object pixel BELOW y=891 on 1024x1536. Absolutely NO curtain, cup, shelf, floor, basket or yarn anywhere above that horizontal line. Shelf top and cup below y=900. Curtain is only a tiny bottom-left sliver below y=910, or omit curtain completely. Wall-floor junction at y=945. Basket and all yarn fully contained in x=90..930, y=980..1450, with basket base at y=1450 and rug foreground below. Basket must be less than 34 percent canvas height INCLUDING yarn. All five products become much smaller in the frame. Shelf is a tiny distant low cubby at far lower right, partly obscured. Reveal a narrow receding floor strip between shelf and basket. Bright soft afternoon window patch ONLY on bottom floor below y=950, gentle broad illumination on blank wall. Do not enlarge yarn to fill frame. Keep cream wall realistic and nuanced, but calm and without strong shadows. This is a mobile background with large intentional top text space. No text. Reduce boucle loop size and regularity to fine irregular yarn loops matching real boucle. Keep exactly five products, pastel product an oblong skein, realistic unlabelled fibers and winding. Only tiny terracotta linen fold, not a large fabric foreground. All constraints above override prior framing.
